title: So cute
text: So cute. I love gnomes And so do some of my family members. That's where my problem comes in because when I purchase some to give away it's hard to decide which ones because I love them all they're so cute

product_metadata.title: 30 Inch Christmas Wreath Gnome, Pine Needle Christmas Gnome Wreath for Front Door, Hanging Ornament Swedish Tomte Christmas Decorations Wreath for Room Window Porch with Led String Lights
features: 【30 Inch Santa Gnome Christmas Wreath】The hanging Christmas wreath is a pine needle Christmas gnome doctor. The Swedish Tomte wreath holds a card printing MERRY CHRISTMAS in his hands to greet everyone.

【Stuffed Fleece Hat & Artificial Pine Needle】The Christmas wreath is made on a high-quality polyester pine needle, durable & non-toxic. And have a stuffed fleece hat, soft & comfortable. And the inside of its hat is supported by iron wires, you can adjust the hat to a different shape.

【With 39-Inch 10 Lamp Beads Led Light String】The Gnome Christmas wreath comes with a 39 inches 10 lamp beads led light string, you can wrap it around the Christmas gnome wreath. BUTTON BATTERIES INCLUDED.

【Best Christmas Greeting】This Santa gnome door hanging wreath is perfect for greeting your guests during the Christmas season. Use this Christmas wreath to decorate your home, adding a Christmas atmosphere and creating a new look to the home. Hang it on the wall, front door, window, porch, or corridor.

【Perfect Christmas Gift】This Christmas wreath gnomes are also known as Tomte or Nisse. In folklore, Swedish gnomes guard home and protect people from misfortune. Santa gnomes elf will bring us good luck, happiness, and warmth. Great gift choice for your family, lovers, and friends to express your Christmas wishes.
